title: The Painted Will
author: Theo Joubert
blurb: Paloma Kavanagh, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
